title: Picture Perfect
description: A better way to see, share and organise your pictures!
body:
# Picture Perfect ![Gallery overview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/672eda31238617ab873a429367f8ada75a774794.png) ## The cleanest looking screenshot mod out there Do you want to see your pictures, but you don't like diving into the games files to see it? In that case: I present to you, Picture Perfect: See, share, organise and manage your pictures how **you** want it: The gallery is aimed to be highly customisable, so you can decide whether you want a feature or not ## All current features: - A picture list - Seeing the pictures enlarged - Copying to clipboard - Renaming pictures - Deleting - Opening in the file explorer - Metadata editor/viewer - Settings: - Amount of columns to display - Distance between each picture (horizontal and vertical) - Scroll speed multiplier - Sorting method - Automatically attaching default metadata fields
## Planned Features: (these will be added in order) - Albums: A collection of images you can see together - Setting images as the title screen background - Adding external images to the game ## Updates This mod is currently in beta, so some features are missing or may be unstable, although the majority is added. Expect updates with bug patches and new features frequently. Bug reports can be posted [here](https://github.com/ItsNukea/Picture-Perfect/issues) ## Requirements: This mod will NOT work without these other mods: - [Cloth config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) - [Mod menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) ## Credits: - Nukea (The solo-dev of this mod) - PyroxIshere (The photographer that took the thumbnail images)
